cases.task: Fix fee() so an explicit zero rate is respected. Preserve the default rate of 0.2 when omitted and retain the existing fee export. Add or update a focused regression test. Work only in fee.js and fee.test.js. Verify the change.

files.fee.js: export function fee(amount, rate) { return amount * (rate || 0.2); }
files.fee.test.js: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {fee} from './fee.js'; assert.equal(fee(100),20);

cases.assertions: const {fee}=await import('./fee.js'); assert.equal(fee(100,0),0); assert.equal(fee(100),20); assert.equal(fee(100,0.1),10); assert.equal(fee(0,0),0);

cases.task: findUser() currently throws for a missing user because it dereferences undefined. Return null for a missing user, preserve the existing successful return shape, and do not mutate records. Add a focused test. Work only in users.js and users.test.js. Verify the change.

files.users.js: export function findUser(users,id) { const u=users.find(u=>u.id===id); return {id:u.id,name:u.name}; }

cases.assertions: const {findUser}=await import('./users.js'); const rows=[{id:1,name:'A',secret:'x'}]; assert.equal(findUser(rows,2),null); assert.deepEqual(findUser(rows,1),{id:1,name:'A'}); assert.deepEqual(rows,[{id:1,name:'A',secret:'x'}]); assert.equal(findUser([],1),null);
